Postdoctoral Researcher in Cosmic Ray and Neutrino Astrophysics (GRAPPA, UvA)

  • Faculty of Science
  • €3,706 - €5,760
  • Closes on
    15-12-2026
  • PhD
  • 38 hours
Are you an ambitious postdoctoral researcher in theoretical astroparticle physics to join the NWO-funded project “Origin of the Most Energetic Neutrino (OMEN)”? GRAPPA Institute at the University of Amsterdam is looking for an ambitious postdoctoral researcher in theoretical astroparticle physics to join the NWO-funded project “Origin of the Most Energetic Neutrino (OMEN)”, led by Shin'ichiro Ando (GRAPPA) and Aart Heijboer (Nikhef and UvA). The recent detection of an ultra-high-energy neutrino by KM3NeT has opened a new window on the most powerful cosmic accelerators. OMEN combines theoretical modelling with KM3NeT data analysis to sharpen what neutrino telescopes can tell us about these sources. The successful candidate will lead the theoretical modelling within the project, with a focus on the propagation and interactions of cosmic rays in magnetic fields, and will contribute to the astrophysical interpretation of high-energy neutrino observations.
